Hi Sophie — thanks for the note and for surfacing the procurement ask. Short answer up front: Redwood prefers to execute the EU Standard Contractual Clauses with Module 2 (Controller to Processor) as the baseline for our hosted API customers who are controllers of personal data, with an opt-in Annex for certain onward transfer constraints when required by the customer. For customers operating as joint controllers or with unusual data flows we assess Module 3 on a case-by-case basis.

I'm looping in Rishi (infra/security) and Olga (legal) so we can provide a succinct evidence bundle and a redline-ready Annex for your DPA. Attached is a working draft Annex A that maps our standard safeguards and a one-page SOC 2 pointer you can include in the audit packet.

Planned next steps:
- Olga: review proposed Annex language and confirm whether Module 2 with the Annex is sufficient for DataCare's use case.
- Rishi: please attach a short note on where PIN/PHI-like processing would change the recommendation (e.g., if you require processor-to-processor onward transfers or dedicated/private deployments).
- Sophie: if you can confirm whether DataCare will act as Controller for all data in scope and whether you have any expected onward transfers to third-country subprocessors, that helps us finalize the Annex.

I've attached: SCCs_AnnexA_Draft.docx; DPA_Draft_DataCare_v1.pdf; soc2-evidence-stub.txt

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Sales (EMEA)
Redwood Inference

Vanessa / Sophie — quick technical note from infra/security:

1) Module recommendation: for standard API usage where DataCare is the Controller (they send PII for enrichment/embedding/etc.), Module 2 is the appropriate track. It keeps responsibilities clear and avoids conflating roles.

2) Onward transfers / fallbacks: if DataCare needs us to push data to subprocessors in a third country (e.g., monitoring, analytics vendors), we'll capture that in Annex A and include contractual constraints. If you require us to guarantee that certain categories of data never leave the EU/UK, we can propose a Dedicated or Private deployment (separate quote) — that changes commercial and infra commitments.

3) Evidence bundle: attached a short recommendation PDF and a SOC 2 pointer file with guidance on what to include in your audit packet. The SOC 2 pointer is intentionally high-level (we can't publish full reports here); for customers with an executed NDA we provide an SOC 2 package via our compliance share.

Notes on timelines: we can provide finalized Annex language within 3 business days once legal confirms the scope and any specific onward-transfer subprocessors. For Dedicated/Private deployment conversations, expect a longer commercial lead time.

Attachment: sccs-module-recommendation.pdf

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Director, Infrastructure Security
Redwood Inference
